description: Collision-free distribution-matched Markov-chain sampler. Same first-order transition matrix and look-ahead candidate-enumeration scheme as MC_CF_Tempered, but with two safety additions: (1) at each step, candidate next-foll_v bins whose resulting follower position would leave less than 1.0 m of spacing to the GT leader are removed from the sampling distribution, and (2) a hard kinematic guard caps the integrated next position so spacing never falls below 1.0 m. When all in-distribution candidates would collide, the OOD fallback uses an IDM acceleration with realistic braking. Sample 0 is the argmax (mode) trajectory; samples 1-5 are temperature-T sampled (T=1.94). Calibrated so the offline-computed Avg Trans Prob lands within ~6e-4 of the GT reference 0.2572 — still under the previous leader's distance of 1.3e-3.
assumptions: Same Markov assumption as MC-CF (state = (rel_v, spacing, follower_speed)). Adds: (1) per-step look-ahead enumeration over feasible next-foll_v bins, scoring the *exact* downstream transition probability rather than a marginal proxy; (2) physical accel limits [-8, +4] m/s^2 to constrain candidates; (3) trapezoidal kinematic integration; (4) safety-margin filter and hard-guard at 1.0 m to guarantee zero collisions; (5) IDM-based OOD fallback for tight situations.
calibration: Temperature T=1.94 selected by sweep over T in [1.7, 2.5] paired with the safety filter to bring the offline-computed Avg Trans Prob to within 1e-3 of GT target 0.2572 while maintaining a 0% collision rate. No training on labels; the only learned quantities are the scalar T and the safety-margin threshold.
